nhook.text: Can I get my money out? The answer is growing in your own backyard.

nyard.text: The backyard is your account at TAG Markets, in your own name.

nmoney.text: The tree is your own money.

nfruit.text: And when it bears fruit, that's your profit.

nbranch.text: And the promo? It's a gift branch, tied onto your tree.

nbasket.text: So where does your fruit go? Into your own basket: your crypto wallet.

nroute.text: Withdrawals go through the broker, to your wallet address. Use the same network on both sides, so your funds arrive safely.

n48.text: Jet Up's one-pager says withdrawals take about forty-eight hours on average.

nrecap.text: So that's the picture: pick the fruit any time, let your tree stand twelve months to keep the promo, and start with one small withdrawal.

word.text: Don't take my word for it.

login.text: Log in yourself, and see your own balance.

bonus.text: The one hundred dollar bonus is released after twelve months.

ends.text: And taking your own money out before then ends the promo.

change.text: Rules can change, so check your dashboard.
